finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Most definitely,” Artemis didn’t disagree as she continued walking with him as if he were entirely disabled.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Then allow me to assist you,” Artemis said as she flashed a smirk of her own before kneeling down and scooping Jake off his feet.
